Name: MAP_PATTERN_SET_PARAM_ST
Description: Map pattern sets: one per Nightlord and map (Standard, each Shifting Earth, Great Hollow). The game picks a set by Weight (Deep of Night: Deep of Night Weight), then one of its Pattern Count patterns from the LotResult params. The modifier lists and counts are input of the offline lottery that generated those results; the game does not read them.

Fields.Name: Weight
Fields.Description: Chance of this set compared with the other sets when an expedition picks its map pattern set. 0: never picked. Deep of Night uses Deep of Night Weight instead.

Fields.Name: Pattern Count
Fields.Description: Number of map patterns this set has in the LotResult params. Patterns are numbered in set order (base sets from 0, sets 1000+ from 1000), so this must match the generated results.

Fields.Name: Extra Major Sites: Weight for 0
Fields.Description: When a pattern of this set is laid out, the game draws how many extra major sites (SmallBaseAndSpotDefine rows 100-199) to add: 0, 1 or 2, weighted by these three fields. This is the weight for none. All three 0: none are added.

Fields.Name: Extra Major Sites: Weight for 1
Fields.Description: Weight for adding one extra major site (see Extra Major Sites: Weight for 0).

Fields.Name: Extra Major Sites: Weight for 2
Fields.Description: Weight for adding two extra major sites (see Extra Major Sites: Weight for 0). Retail: 25 on Heolstor's and Straghess's sets, where the weight for none is 0.

Fields.Name: Deep of Night Weight
Fields.Description: Chance of this set compared with the other sets in Deep of Night, instead of Weight. 0: never picked in Deep of Night.

Fields.Name: Event Modifier 1
Fields.Description: Event modifier 1 of this set (e.g. 180 Mass Enemy Spawn, 200 Meteor Strike, 604 Night Boss Interference; 0: no event). Offline lottery input: Event Modifier 1 Count patterns get it in LotResultMapPatternFlag. Not read by the game.
